name: Generation X

tenures.source: The biography sheets of Richard Bison, D-Frost, Dragon, Merce and Rachel Ellerton each name Generation X as the stable; the news of 4 September 2004 shows all its members attacking The Regulators and Gekido on Shockers.

caption: A stable of the EWA's 2004 pages, led by Richard Bison, whose members attacked the Regulators and Gekido on Shockers on 28 August 2004 and put Brett Cotter over Travis for the Tag titles.

identity.note: The same name stands on 1 other wing record. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this stable or team to it, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one.

name: The Regulators

tenures.source: Its team page: members Brett Cotter, Michael Bendis, Superbeast, with combined accomplishments.

caption: A team of the EWA's 2004 pages: Brett Cotter, Michael Bendis and Superbeast, whose page counts two EWA Tag Team Championships for Cotter and Bendis, a TV and a European title for Cotter and a Cruiserweight title for Bendis.

identity.note: The same name stands on 4 other wing records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this stable or team to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one.

name: Ballbusters Inc

tenures.source: Its BBI team page (Brett Cotter and Slayer, 487 pounds combined) and the news of 2 September 2004 on Superbeast joining the Ballbusters Inc.

caption: The EWA's Ballbusters Inc (BBI), listed on its team pages with Brett Cotter and Slayer and joined by Superbeast on 2 September 2004.

name: Gekido

tenures.source: Its Gekido team page (Tetsuo & Travis, 470 lbs combined) and the Tag Team Championship page.

caption: Tetsuo and Travis, the tag team whose entrance, finisher (the Gekido Kick) and signature moves its team page describes and who hold the Tag titles twice on its championship page.

name: The Brittish Revolution

tenures.source: Its team page: members Matt Nitro and Lotus, finisher London Calling.

caption: A team of Matt Nitro and Lotus whose page gives the finisher London Calling and an entrance with a Union Jack and a crossed-out American flag.

name: D-Xtreme

tenures.source: Its D-Xtreme team page: members Dalis Hyral and Denim Hyral.

caption: A team of the brothers Dalis (D-Frost) and Denim Hyral, whose team page holds only their names.

name: The Partnership

tenures.source: Its Partnership team page: members Brett Cotter and Jonah Hex, with the Ballbusters Inc symbol in their entrance.

caption: A team of Brett Cotter and Jonah Hex whose entrance carries the Ballbusters Inc symbol and whose team finisher is the Bonebreaker.
